title: Erase Personal Data
intro: WordPress erases or anonymizes the personal data for an email address after the person confirms a request. In Backdrop the equivalent is cancelling the user account, which offers to delete or anonymize the account’s content.
backdrop: Open the account on the People page, choose Cancel account, then pick one of: disable the account and keep its content; disable and unpublish its content; delete the account and make its content belong to “Anonymous”; delete the account and its content.

sections.heading: Comments by anonymous visitors
sections.text: Comments posted without an account keep the name and email entered; delete them under Comments, or edit them to remove the details.
